details.name: Best food in JBR! Authentic Khaleeji flavors and the family section is spotless. Halal certified, has a prayer area, and the iftar buffet during Ramadan is unbeatable. Will keep coming back.
Waited 35 minutes for our order, food came cold. Staff was unfriendly when we asked about it. Disappointing for the prices.
اكل لذيذ والخدمه راقيه. القسم العائلي مريح بس المواقف صعبه يوم الجمعه.

title: Searched for bayt al khaleej menu
